vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: compound-eng-file-todos
Version: 3.0.1

The skill bundle provides a structured framework for file-based task tracking using Markdown files in a dedicated 'todos/' directory. It includes templates and bash-based workflows (using standard tools like grep, ls, and awk) for managing issue lifecycles, dependencies, and work logs. There are no indicators of malicious intent, data exfiltration, or unauthorized command execution; all instructions are strictly aligned with the stated purpose of project management.

llm.summary: The skill's files and instructions consistently describe a file-based todo system operating on markdown files in a todos/ directory; there are no unexpected credential requests or installs and the behavior is proportionate to its purpose.

dimensions.detail: The name/description match the included files (templates, workflows, quick-reference). All actions described (create, triage, rename, search, update todos) operate on markdown files in todos/. Minor note: the workflows mention integration items like a slash command (/ia-triage) and 'gh CLI' in a table, but the skill declares no required binaries — this is a documentation/information mismatch (not a security concern by itself) that could confuse users if they expect the skill to invoke those tools automatically.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md explicitly confines operations to the repo's todos/ directory and bundled assets (copying template, renaming files, updating frontmatter, grep/ls searches). It does not instruct reading unrelated system files, environment variables, or contacting external endpoints. The instructions assume standard shell utilities (ls, grep, mv, cp, awk) but do not demand network calls or secret access.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files — this is instruction-only. Nothing is downloaded or written by an installer, which lowers risk.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables, credentials, or config paths. The requested access (filesystem under todos/) is proportionate to its stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and disable-model-invocation:true (the skill cannot be autonomously invoked by the model) reduce blast radius. The skill does not request system-wide persistence or modify other skills' configurations.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is instruction-only and operates on markdown todo files in a todos/ directory. Before using it, verify the todos/ directory is the one you intend the skill to modify (back it up or put examples in a sandbox if unsure). Note the docs mention shell commands and optional integrations (slash commands, gh CLI) but the skill won't install or require those automatically — you'll need the appropriate CLI tools if you plan to run the listed commands yourself. If you need the skill to run external tools or network services, ask the maintainer for an explicit install spec and required env variables; that would change the security profile.
